title: FX London breakout continuation
thesis: Major FX pairs may continue after a London session breakout when Asian range compression is unusually tight.
market_intuition: Compressed Asian sessions can precede directional London breakouts if volatility expands with follow-through instead of immediate rejection.
entry_idea: Enter in breakout direction after the first 15m close outside the Asian range.
exit_idea: Exit at fixed multiple, trailing stop, or London close.
risk_assumption: Risk 0.5R-1R per trade with stop on opposite side of the Asian range.
cost_slippage_assumption: Use spread by pair and stress with wider London-open spread.
data_source: Broker FX OHLCV with session timestamps in UTC.
disproof_condition: Reject if profitability vanishes when breakout entries are delayed one bar.

clarification_answers.q_filter: No discretionary news filter in baseline.
